data.one_liner: Flutter storage engine for redux_persist, saving state to a file or shared preferences.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FlutterStorage class that persists Redux state to the app's document directory or to shared preferences. Supports web via shared preferences and includes null‑safety support.
use_when: You need simple persistence of Redux state across app launches
You want a cross‑platform solution (mobile + web) without a full database
You prefer a file or key‑value store over SQL
avoid_when: You require encrypted or secure storage
You need to query large structured data
strengths: Very easy to integrate with redux_persist
Works on mobile and web out of the box
Supports both file and shared‑preferences storage
weaknesses: Limited to key‑value/file storage, not suitable for complex queries
Tied to redux_persist, not a general purpose storage

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Direct key‑value storage without the Redux layer

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides encrypted storage for sensitive data

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: Full SQLite database when you need complex queries or large data
